scenario: One Today decision through exact fact review, exact reminder approval, unknown execution, exact readback, and verified or failed outcome, with AX5 dark reduced-motion and ambiguous-identity recovery.
frozen_evidence: Clean final browser replay: Today, fact, approval, unknown, verified, mismatch-to-failed, and visible focus; zero warning/error console entries.
npm run build; npm run test:evidence; npm run test:sites; pnpm docs:check

review_plan.reason: Owns task comprehension, interruption cost, provenance clarity, and recruiter trust.
Owns identity, evidence, authorization, effect, outcome, and hard-veto integrity.
Owns executable mobile interaction, accessibility, focus, keyboard, and recovery.
Owns candidate trust, dignity, truthful follow-through, and bounded human authority.
Owns visual hierarchy, calmness, ownability, and Talent Signal design fidelity.
This flow contains no assessment, evaluator score, candidate comparison, or person-ranking claim.

reviews.lens: boutique recruiter task comprehension, interruption recovery, provenance clarity, and trust

findings.observation: The Today card shows channel, month/day, and time while year and timezone appear on the next fact-review screen.
findings.evidence: Direct 393x852 render and Prototype.tsx Today card at lines 391-405.
findings.user_impact: The first card is compact, but full audit-grade provenance requires entering review.
findings.recommendation: Keep the compact label unless human testing shows recruiters need year and timezone before opening review.
findings.verification: The fact screen exposes full captured date, time, speaker, and Asia/Shanghai before any write approval.

strengths: One decision, one dependency, one quote, and one primary action are independently scannable.
Unknown and failed states preserve the approved reminder context for interruption recovery.

reviews.lens: identity, evidence, authorization, effect, and observed-outcome integrity
strengths: Execution enters UNKNOWN, exact readback alone produces VERIFIED, mismatch produces NOT APPLIED, and ambiguous identity stays unbound.
The live state model has no dead reconciled state or implied bookkeeping write.
missing_evidence: Production connector-backed reminder readback remains outside this prototype proof.

reviews.lens: mobile completion, interaction feel, accessibility, focus, keyboard, scroll, and recovery
strengths: Direct AX5 dark reduced-motion replay passed at 393x852 without horizontal overflow.
Keyboard-open send, scroll reset, 44-48px critical targets, and visible plain-button focus all passed.

reviews.lens: candidate trust, dignity, truthful follow-through, and bounded human authority
strengths: The reminder is recruiter-owned, sends no candidate message, changes no candidate record, and keeps uncertainty visible.
Evidence derivation and correction remain attributable rather than being presented as source text.

reviews.lens: quiet visual hierarchy, calmness, ownability, interaction clarity, and mobile polish

findings.observation: The vermilion keyboard focus ring is intentionally more assertive than the interface at rest.
findings.evidence: Direct focused-control render and prototype.css focus override at lines 60-64.
findings.user_impact: Keyboard focus is unmistakable; the brief emphasis is stronger than the surrounding quiet palette.
findings.recommendation: Retain the current ring because accessibility and orientation outweigh the transient tonal contrast.
findings.verification: The ring appears only on true focus-visible state and remains clean against light and dark surfaces.

strengths: Today is calm and owned by one decision rather than a dashboard feed.
The fact, effect, unknown, and verified surfaces each keep one legible causal seam and one primary action.

top_findings.reason: The compact Today label omits year and timezone while the next fact screen restores full provenance before any write.
top_findings.next_step: Test the compact source label in the separate real-human comprehension gate rather than adding dashboard density preemptively.
top_findings.verification: Recruiters can identify the source and timing without hesitation, and the two 9/10 comprehension gates pass.

agreements: All five selected specialists scored the identical frozen artifact above 95/100.
The focused flow has no active blocker, high finding, or domain veto.
Fact, effect, unknown execution, readback-confirmed outcome, and failed outcome remain distinct and truthful.
The mobile surface is executable at AX5 dark reduced-motion with visible focus and no horizontal overflow.

veto_resolution.veto: The prototype claimed external success before destination readback.
veto_resolution.evidence: The final executing state advances to UNKNOWN; only exact field-by-field readback advances to VERIFIED, and mismatch advances to NOT APPLIED.

adjudication.rationale: The exact frozen artifact passes every selected specialist lens without averaging scores or hiding jurisdiction-specific findings. The remaining provenance note is low severity and full provenance is visible before approval. Prototype-fixture readback is explicitly excluded from production connector proof.

next_tests.test: Run the separate real-human MX-01 comprehension gate on this exact frozen candidate.
next_tests.evidence_required: Predeclared human packets and results bound to freeze-candidate-v8.json.
next_tests.pass_condition: Both human comprehension gates reach at least 9/10 without reopening a safety veto.

next_tests.test: Replace the deterministic reminder fixture with connector-backed exact readback while preserving the UNKNOWN and NOT APPLIED paths.
next_tests.evidence_required: Destination receipt containing operation ID, destination, title, note, absolute schedule, and idempotency evidence.
next_tests.pass_condition: Exact match alone records VERIFIED; mismatch or timeout remains UNKNOWN or NOT APPLIED; retry cannot create a duplicate.
